mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates stronger economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 against 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between GDPC1 and 20-day returns is negative in more than 60% of the 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.25% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.25% against 20-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a weak labor market with accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations through lower discount rates and higher expected earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction of UNRATE > 5.5 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5 against 20-day returns is below 0.03, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO < 105 against 20-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03, or the average 20-day return in INDPRO < 105 periods is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) are associated with positive equity returns because they reduce the cost of capital, supporting higher equity valuations and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 60-day forward returns is below 0.03, or the correlation is negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market and potential wage inflation, which may lead to Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for UNRATE < 5.0 against 5-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03, or the average 5-day return in triggered periods is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1100) and rising industrial production (INDPRO > 107) indicates robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction of HOUST > 1100 and INDPRO > 107 against 60-day returns is below 0.03, or the average 60-day return in triggered periods is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Higher levels of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate stronger labor market conditions, which support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS against 5-day forward returns is below 0.03, or the correlation is negative.
